desc:
Start with a small rocket and work your way up to building massive spaceships capable of exploring the entire solar system! 🌍

🔧 Build and customize your own rockets!  
🚀 Launch your rockets into space!  
💰 Earn money and build bigger, better rockets!  
🌙 Travel to the Moon, Mars, and other planets!  
🪐 Explore the solar system and discover new worlds!  
🔥 Experiment with different rocket designs!  
🌌 Become the ultimate space explorer!

Can you build a rocket powerful enough to reach all the planets? 👀

👍 Like the game for more updates!
